parameters.name: Direction
parameters.description:
The sorting order. Valid values:

- DESC: Descending order. This is the default value.

- ASC: Ascending order.

parameters.name: DomainType
parameters.description:
The type of the domain name. This parameter is not case-sensitive. Valid values:

- PUBLIC: authoritative domain name (default)

- CACHE: authoritative proxy domain name

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh: Chinese

- en: English

Default value: en

parameters.name: OrderBy
parameters.description:
The field to sort the results by. Valid values:

- createDate: Sorts the results by creation time. This is the default value.

- expireDate: Sorts the results by expiration time.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. Pages start from **1**. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: **100**. Default value: **20**.

parameters.name: VersionCode
parameters.description: The edition code of the Alibaba Cloud DNS instance.
